activities.name: Active Comparator Drug
activities.definition: A therapeutically active agent that is intended to provide baseline measurements for the experimental protocol of a clinical trial.

activities.name: Actual Subject Number
activities.definition: The actual number of subjects entered into a clinical trial.

activities.name: Adaptive Study Design Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether a study's design includes a prospectively planned opportunity for modification of one or more specified aspects of the study design and/or hypotheses based on analysis of data, usually interim data.

activities.name: Additional Outcome Measure
activities.definition: Additional key measures that will be used to evaluate the intervention(s) or, for observational studies, that are a focus of the study, but which are not considered primary or secondary outcome measures.

activities.name: Adverse Event
activities.definition: Any unfavorable or unintended disease, sign, or symptom (including an abnormal laboratory finding) that is temporally associated with the use of a medical treatment or procedure, and that may or may not be considered related to the medical treatment or procedure. activities.name: Age
activities.definition: SDTM DM domain: Age

activities.name: Biospecimen Retained and/or Contains DNA Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether biospecimens have been retained and/or whether those retained biospecimens contain DNA.

activities.name: Biospecimen Retention Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the biological specimen is retained for a period of time.

activities.name: Birth Date and Time
activities.definition: The date and time of a birth event.

activities.name: Blinded Description
activities.definition: The textual representation of the activity on a blinded participant or study subject (from the point of view of the study investigator).

activities.name: CDISC Therapeutic Area User Guide Name and Version
activities.definition: The name and version of the CDISC therapeutic area user guide that is being used in the study submission.

activities.name: Challenge Agent Name
activities.definition: The name of the non-investigational medicinal product (NIMP) given to trial subjects to produce a physiological response that is necessary before the pharmacological action of the investigational medicinal product can be assessed. activities.name: Character
activities.definition: Any single letter, number, or symbol.

activities.name: Citation Description
activities.definition: A bibliographical reference in an acceptable format.

activities.name: Class of Trial Agent
activities.definition: A classification of the type of trial agent.

activities.name: Clinical Study
activities.definition: Research conducted with human subjects or on material of human origin in which an investigator directly interacts with human subjects; includes development of new technologies, study of mechanisms of human diseases, therapy, clinical trials, epidemiologic, behavior, and health services research.

activities.name: Clinical Study by Intent
activities.definition: The planned purpose of the therapy, device, or agent under study in the clinical study.

activities.name: Clinical Study Citation
activities.definition: A bibliographical reference to a particular study.

activities.name: Clinical Study End Date
activities.definition: The date on which the study concludes.

activities.name: Clinical Study Functional Role
activities.definition: The responsibility assumed by a person administering any activities within a clinical study.

activities.name: Clinical Study Report Archive Date
activities.definition: The date when the clinical study report was archived.

activities.name: Clinical Study Sponsor
activities.definition: An entity such as an individual, company, institution, group, or organization which takes responsibility for the initiation, management, and/or financing of a clinical study. The sponsor does not actually conduct the investigation unless the sponsor is a sponsor-investigator. A person other than an

activities.name: Clinical Trial Objective
activities.definition: The main purpose of an investigation that can be measured objectively to determine whether the treatment or intervention being studied is beneficial.

activities.name: Clinical Trial Registry Identifier
activities.definition: A sequence of letters, numbers, or other characters that uniquely identifies a clinical trial within a clinical trial registry.

activities.name: Clinical Trials Design
activities.definition: The detailed planning of studies of the safety, efficacy, or optimum dosage schedule (if appropriate) of one or more diagnostic, therapeutic, or prophylactic drugs, devices, or techniques selected according to predetermined criteria of eligibility and observed for predefined evidence of favorable an

activities.name: Clinicaltrials.gov Identifier
activities.definition: The unique alphanumeric identifier for a trial as assigned by the Clinicaltrials.gov Protocol Registration and Results System (PRS).

activities.name: Clinicaltrials.gov NCT Number for the Expanded Access Record
activities.definition: The unique alphanumeric identifier for a study with associated expanded access record, as assigned by the clinicaltrials.gov PRS system.

activities.name: Complete
activities.definition: To possess every necessary or normal part or component or step; having come or been brought to a conclusion.

activities.name: Component of Study Protocol
activities.definition: A component of a plan on which a study is based.

activities.name: Confirmed Response Minimum Duration
activities.definition: The minimum amount of time required to meet the criteria for a confirmed response to treatment.

activities.name: Contact Name
activities.definition: The name of the person acting as a channel for communication between groups or on behalf of a group.

activities.name: Control Type
activities.definition: A characteristic of a treatment regimen employed as a comparator against which the study treatment is evaluated.

activities.name: Country of Manufacture
activities.definition: The name of the country within which the product under study is made.

activities.name: Criterion
activities.definition: That which constitutes a standard from which a judgment can be established, a reference point against which other things can be evaluated, or a basis for comparison.

activities.name: Current Therapy
activities.definition: The name of the therapy that is currently being administered.

activities.name: Data Cutoff Date
activities.definition: The date on which subsequently collected data will not be considered as part of the analysis.

activities.name: Data Cutoff Date Description
activities.definition: A textual description of the data cutoff date.

activities.name: Data Monitoring Committee Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether a clinical trial has an appointed data monitoring committee.

activities.name: Date
activities.definition: The particular day, month and year an event has happened or will happen.

activities.name: Date/Time of Birth
activities.definition: SDTM DM domain: Date/Time of Birth

activities.name: Dead
activities.definition: The cessation of life.

activities.name: Description
activities.definition: A written or verbal account, representation, statement, or explanation of something.

activities.name: Diagnosis Group
activities.definition: A grouping of individuals on the basis of a shared procedure or disease, or lack thereof (e.g. healthy volunteers, type 2 diabetic subjects, subjects with renal cell cancer).  Standardized naming systems are available that define the groups within which a subject should be placed.

activities.name: Diagnostic Criteria
activities.definition: A standard from which a judgment concerning a medical diagnosis can be established.

activities.name: Diagnostic, Therapeutic, or Research Equipment
activities.definition: A manufactured object that is used to perform diagnostic, therapeutic or research activities.

activities.name: Dosage Form Unit
activities.definition: The unit of measure for the dosage form.

activities.name: Dose
activities.definition: A quantity of an agent (such as substance or energy) administered, taken, or absorbed at one time.

activities.name: Dose Frequency
activities.definition: The number of times a substance is administered within a specific time period.

activities.name: Dose Modification
activities.definition: Change, alteration, or adjustment of a dose specified in a treatment plan or/and administered to a patient.

activities.name: Dose Regimen
activities.definition: A treatment plan that specifies the amount, schedule, and the duration of intervention(s).

activities.name: Duration
activities.definition: The period of time during which something continues.

activities.name: E-mail Address
activities.definition: A text string identifier for a location to which e-mail can be delivered.

activities.name: E-mail Address for XML File Feedback
activities.definition: The E-mail address to which copies of the XML format of the CT application should be sent.

activities.name: ECG Continuous Monitoring Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the 10-second ECGs for this study were extracted from a continuous recording.

activities.name: ECG Evaluator Blinding Parameters
activities.definition: A description of the parameters to which the ECG assessors were blinded to within the study.

activities.name: ECG Measurement
activities.definition: Measurements or calculations on measurements obtained from electrocardiographic tracings.

activities.name: ECG Planned Primary Lead for Study
activities.definition: A description of the ECG lead that is planned to be used as the planned, primary lead for the study.

activities.name: ECG Read Method Degree of Automation
activities.definition: The degree of automation of the method by which the ECG output is read by the evaluator.

activities.name: ECG Replicates at Baseline Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether replicate ECGs for time points during the baseline portion of the study were included.

activities.name: ECG Replicates On-Treatment Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether replicate ECGs for time points during the on-treatment portion of the study were included.

activities.name: ECG T Wave Algorithm
activities.definition: The defined procedure used to identify the end of the T wave.

activities.name: ECG Used Same Lead Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether ECG interval measurements were based on the same lead.

activities.name: Eligibility Criteria Met
activities.definition: SDTM DS domain: Eligibility Criteria Met

activities.name: Eligibility Criteria Met By Subject
activities.definition: An indication that the subject has fulfilled the criteria needed to continue to the next study period.

activities.name: EMA Decision Number for Pediatric Investigation Plan
activities.definition: An alphnumeric code assigned by the European Medicines Agency (EMA) to an EMA regulatory decision.

activities.name: End Date
activities.definition: The calendar date on which something is to terminate or did terminate.

activities.name: Epidemic or Pandemic Related Disruption Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the study disruption was caused by the epidemic or pandemic.

activities.name: Ethnic Group
activities.definition: A social group characterized by a distinctive social and cultural tradition that is maintained from generation to generation. Members share a common history and origin and a sense of identification with the group. They have similar and distinctive features in their lifestyle habits and shared experi

activities.name: Ethnicity
activities.definition: SDTM DM domain: Ethnicity

activities.name: EudraCT Resubmission Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the trial being submitted to the EudraCT is a trial that has been previously submitted to the EudraCT system and withdrawn.

activities.name: EudraVigilance Sender Identifier
activities.definition: A unique identifier assigned to the organization that is transmitting an adverse drug reaction report to the EudraVigilance system.

activities.name: EudraVigilance Sender Organization
activities.definition: The name of the group or institution that is transmitting an adverse drug reaction report to the EudraVigilance system.

activities.name: Exclusion Criteria 01
activities.definition: SDTM IE domain: Exclusion Criteria 01

activities.name: Exploratory Outcome Measure
activities.definition: Exploratory measures that are used to evaluate and/or form hypotheses about the intervention outcome(s).

activities.name: Extension Trial Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the clinical trial is an extension trial.

activities.name: Failure To Meet Continuation Criteria
activities.definition: An indication that the subject has not been able to meet protocol-defined continuation criteria and will not continue to participate in the clinical trial.

activities.name: Failure to Meet Randomization Criteria
activities.definition: An indication that the subject has been unable to fulfill the criteria required for assignment into a randomized group.

activities.name: FDA Technical Specification Name and Version
activities.definition: The name and version of the FDA technical specification that is being used in the study submission.

activities.name: FDA-Regulated Device Study Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the study involves an FDA-regulated device.

activities.name: FDA-Regulated Drug Study Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the study involves an FDA-regulated drug.

activities.name: Geographic Area
activities.definition: Any demarcated area of the Earth; may be determined by both natural and human boundaries.

activities.name: Health Issue Related Group
activities.definition: Groups that have a focus on health issues.

activities.name: Health Risk Assessment
activities.definition: An estimated probability that one or more adverse event(s) will occur as a result of exposure to an actual or potential hazardous situation or chemical.

activities.name: Healthy Subject Indicator
activities.definition: Specifies whether an individual who is or becomes a participant in a research study and has no significant health-related issues including those related to the condition being tested.

activities.name: Identifier
activities.definition: One or more characters used to identify, name, or characterize the nature, properties, or contents of a thing.

activities.name: Inclusion Criteria 01
activities.definition: SDTM IE domain: Inclusion Criteria 01

activities.name: Indication
activities.definition: A sign, signal, circumstance, or symptom which serves to indicate or point out the cause, pathology, treatment, or issue of an attack of disease; the basis for initiation of a treatment for a disease or of a diagnostic test (causal, or symptomatic, or disease-specific indication).

activities.name: Indicator
activities.definition: An event, entity or condition that typically characterizes a prescribed environment or situation and determines or aids in determining whether certain stated circumstances exist or criteria are satisfied.

activities.name: Informed Consent
activities.definition: Consent by a patient to a surgical or medical procedure or participation in a clinical study after achieving an understanding of the relevant medical facts and the risks involved.

activities.name: Informed Consent Obtained
activities.definition: SDTM DS domain: Informed Consent Obtained

activities.name: Intervention Duration
activities.definition: The period of time during which an intervention continues.

activities.name: Intervention Model
activities.definition: The trial design developed to compare treatment groups.

activities.name: Intervention Type
activities.definition: The kind of product or procedure studied in a trial.

activities.name: Keyword
activities.definition: A word or small set of words designed to convey the subject of a technical article.

activities.name: Knowledge Field
activities.definition: A branch of knowledge.

activities.name: Lack of Efficacy
activities.definition: The lack of expected or desired effect related to a therapy.

activities.name: Lead Device
activities.definition: An insulated electrical conductor designed to connect to an electrical device.

activities.name: Lost to Follow Up
activities.definition: SDTM DS domain: Lost to Follow Up

activities.name: Lost To Follow-Up
activities.definition: The loss or lack of continuation of subject participation after a study has officially closed.

activities.name: Multiple Site European Union State Trial Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the clinical study is being conducted at multiple sites within the European Union member state concerned by the application.
synonyms: Multiple Site EU State Trial Indicator

activities.name: Name
activities.definition: The words or language units by which a thing is known.

activities.name: Name and Version
activities.definition: An identifier that includes the words or language units by which a thing is known and the form or variant of the original.

activities.name: Name of Epidemic or Pandemic
activities.definition: The literal identifier of the epidemic or pandemic.

activities.name: Non-Protocol Disposition Event
activities.definition: The group of incidents that are not driven by the protocol but that may occur during a clinical trial and describe whether a subject completed the study epoch or the reason this event did not occur.

activities.name: Number
activities.definition: A numeral or string of numerals expressing value, quantity, or identification.

activities.name: Number of Groups or Cohorts
activities.definition: The number of groups or cohorts that are part of the study.

activities.name: Number of Trial Sites within European Union State
activities.definition: The number of trial sites within a European Union state.
synonyms: Number of Trial Sites EU State

activities.name: Observational Model
activities.definition: The trial design developed to compare biomedical and/or health outcomes in pre-defined and non-assigned groups of individuals.

activities.name: Observational Study Population Description
activities.definition: A textual description of the population group from which the group or cohort will be selected for observational studies.

activities.name: Observational Study Sampling Method
activities.definition: The process by which subjects are selected to participate in observational studies.

activities.name: Observational Study Sampling Method Description
activities.definition: A textual description of the sampling method used to assign study participants into groups or cohorts within an observational study.

activities.name: Observational Time Perspective of Study
activities.definition: The temporal relationship between the observation period and time of subject enrollment. (ClinicalTrials.gov)

activities.name: Ongoing Study Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the study is in progress.

activities.name: Organization Name
activities.definition: A textual identifier for an organization.

activities.name: Pediatric Investigation Plan Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the trial is part of the pediatric investigation plan.

activities.name: Pediatric Postmarket Study Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the study is a pediatric postmarket study.

activities.name: Pediatric Study Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the study is a pediatric study.

activities.name: Pharmaceutical Dosage Form
activities.definition: The form in which active and/or inert ingredient(s) are physically presented.

activities.name: Pharmacological Class of Investigational Therapy
activities.definition: The drug class of the therapy being investigated in the study or trial.

activities.name: Phase
activities.definition: A distinguishable part, a stage in a series of events or in a process of development, e.g. any of the varying aspects or stages in course of a disease; a fraction of a cycle.

activities.name: Physician Decision
activities.definition: A position, opinion or judgment reached after consideration by a physician with reference to subject.

activities.name: Planned Country of Investigational Site
activities.definition: The planned country within which the investigation, trial or study is taking place.

activities.name: Planned Duration
activities.definition: The period of time over which the event or activity is intended to take place.

activities.name: Planned Follow-Up Duration
activities.definition: The anticipated time period over which each study participant is to be followed. (clinicaltrials.gov)

activities.name: Planned Maximum Age of Subjects
activities.definition: The anticipated maximum age of the subjects to be entered in a clinical trial.

activities.name: Planned Minimum Age of Subjects
activities.definition: The anticipated minimum age of the subjects to be entered in a clinical trial.

activities.name: Planned Number of Arms
activities.definition: The planned number of intervention groups.

activities.name: Planned Subject Number
activities.definition: The number of subjects entered in a clinical trial.

activities.name: Planned Treatment Duration
activities.definition: The period of time during which the treatment is intended to be given.

activities.name: Planned Trial Duration
activities.definition: The approximate period of time over which a clinical trial is planned to occur.

activities.name: Post Authorization Safety Study Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the clinical study is a post authorization safety study.

activities.name: Postal Address
activities.definition: A physical location used by a person or organization for the purpose of receiving postal mail deliveries.

activities.name: Potency Unit
activities.definition: The basic quantity or increment used to describe the strength of a product or amount of product in a package.

activities.name: Pregnant Subject
activities.definition: An indication that the study subject is pregnant.

activities.name: Primary Outcome Measure
activities.definition: The primary measurement(s) or observation(s) used to measure the effect of experimental variables in a study, or for observational studies, to describe patterns of diseases or traits or associations with exposures, risk factors or treatment. These are the outcome measures used to assess the primary

activities.name: Progressive Disease
activities.definition: A clinical, pathologic, and/or molecular finding indicating that the course of a disease is worsening in terms of extent or severity.

activities.name: Property or Attribute
activities.definition: A distinguishing quality or prominent aspect of a person, object, action, process, or substance.

activities.name: Protocol Agent
activities.definition: A medical product, practice, or application that is tested in a clinical trial.

activities.name: Protocol Completed
activities.definition: SDTM DS domain: Protocol Completed

activities.name: Protocol Deviation
activities.definition: A variation from processes or procedures defined in a protocol. Deviations usually do not preclude the overall evaluability of subject data for either efficacy or safety, and are often acknowledged and accepted in advance by the sponsor. (CDISC Glossary)

activities.name: Protocol Disposition Event
activities.definition: The group of incidents that occur during a clinical trial and describe whether a subject completed the study epoch or the reason this event did not occur. The subject's disposition is often described for each phase of the study.

activities.name: Protocol Keyword
activities.definition: A word or small set of words designed to convey the subject of a clinical study.

activities.name: Protocol Milestone
activities.definition: Occurrences within some epochs that are initiated by a protocol-specified event. The most common protocol milestone is "Informed Consent Obtained" which usually documents the start of the study.

activities.name: Protocol Risk Assessment
activities.definition: The potential future harm that may arise from some protocol-related activity.

activities.name: Publication Identifier
activities.definition: A unique symbol that establishes identity to a publication.

activities.name: PubMed Unique Identifier
activities.definition: A globally unique identifier for a biomedical article, as assigned by PubMed.
synonyms: PubMed ID for Citation Used in Study

activities.name: Quotient
activities.definition: A quantity obtained by division.

activities.name: Race
activities.definition: A geographic ancestral origin category that is assigned to a population group based mainly on physical characteristics that are thought to be distinct and inherent.

activities.name: Randomization
activities.definition: The allocation of individuals to groups by chance, especially in order to control the variables in an experiment.

activities.name: Randomization Quotient
activities.definition: The number of planned subjects to be exposed to investigational therapy, independent of dose or other factors, divided by the total number of planned subjects.

activities.name: Randomized
activities.definition: SDTM DS domain: Randomized

activities.name: Rare Disease Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the condition under study is considered a rare or orphan disease.

activities.name: Relapse Criteria
activities.definition: A standard from which a judgment concerning a disease relapse can be established.

activities.name: Requires Secure Email Delivery of XML Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the XML copy of the CT application requires secure E-mail delivery.

activities.name: Resubmission Letter
activities.definition: An alphabetic character that describes the incremental order of trial submissions or resubmissions.

activities.name: Retained Biospecimen Contains DNA Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether retained biospecimens contain DNA.

activities.name: Retained Biospecimen Description
activities.definition: A textual description of the specimen types, which are collected during the course of the study.

activities.name: Route
activities.definition: A way of getting from one place to another; an established line of travel or access; the way a chemical or pollutant enters an organism after contact, particularly, the way of drug administration.

activities.name: Route of Administration
activities.definition: Designation of the part of the body through which or into which, or the way in which, the medicinal product is intended to be introduced. In some cases a medicinal product can be intended for more than one route and/or method of administration.

activities.name: Sampling Method
activities.definition: A statistical process of selecting a subset, or sample, from a larger population. Information is gathered from that sample and analyzed in order to gain insights about the larger group.

activities.name: SDTM Implementation Guide Medical Device Version
activities.definition: The version of the CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model implementation guide for medical devices that is being used in the study submission.

activities.name: Secondary Outcome Measure
activities.definition: Other key measures that will be used to evaluate the intervention(s) or, for observational studies, that are a focus of the study. These are the outcome measures used to assess the secondary objective(s).

activities.name: Severity Criteria
activities.definition: A standard from which a judgment concerning an event severity can be established.

activities.name: Sex
activities.definition: An arbitrary categorization of individuals based on the assemblage of physical properties related to reproduction, and commonly associated with the designation of such categories as female and male. This designation is based on a combination of observable information from organ inventories, morpholo

activities.name: Sex of Study Group
activities.definition: The specific sex, either male, female, or mixed of the subject group being studied.

activities.name: Single Site European Union State Trial Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the clinical study is being conducted at only one site within the European Union member state concerned by the application.
synonyms: Single Site EU State Trial Indicator

activities.name: Site Transfer
activities.definition: SDTM DS domain: Site Transfer

activities.name: Sponsor
activities.definition: A person or organization that supports or champions something.

activities.name: Sponsor Commercial Status
activities.definition: The state or condition of the sponsor as it pertains to whether the sponsor is considered a commercial entity.

activities.name: Sponsor Study Reference Identifier
activities.definition: The reference identifier that is assigned by the sponsor and by which the study is known to the sponsor.

activities.name: Stable Disease Minimum Duration
activities.definition: The minimum amount of time required to meet the definition of stable disease.

activities.name: Start Date
activities.definition: The calendar date on which something is to start or did start.

activities.name: Status
activities.definition: A condition or state at a particular time.

activities.name: Stratification Factors
activities.definition: Selected pre-treatment factors by which patients are segregated to assure equal balance of these factors before randomization to the intervention arms of a clinical protocol.

activities.name: Study Contact E-mail Address
activities.definition: A text string identifier for a location to which e-mail for the study contact can be delivered.

activities.name: Study Contact Name
activities.definition: A non-unique textual identifier for the study contact.

activities.name: Study Contact Postal Address
activities.definition: A physical location used by a study contact for the purpose of receiving postal mail deliveries.

activities.name: Study Contact Role
activities.definition: A title that describes the function of a study contact within their organization.

activities.name: Study Contact Telephone Number
activities.definition: A sequence of decimal digits (0-9) that is used for identifying a destination telephone line or other device in a telephone network that is used by the study contact.

activities.name: Study Data Tabulation Model Implementation Guide Version
activities.definition: The version of the CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model implementation guide that is being used in the study submission.

activities.name: Study Data Tabulation Model Version
activities.definition: The version of the CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model that is being used in the study submission.

activities.name: Study Design
activities.definition: A plan detailing how a study will be performed in order to represent the phenomenon under examination, to answer the research questions that have been asked, and defining the methods of data analysis. Study design is driven by research hypothesis being posed, study subject/population/sample availabl

activities.name: Study Population Description
activities.definition: A textual description of the target study population which contains precisely defined characteristics of potential participants. This includes inclusion and exclusion criteria, the number of potential participants, conditions of recruitment and sample structure, information on vulnerable population(

activities.name: Study Protocol Uniform Resource Locator
activities.definition: The uniform resource locator for a clinical study protocol.

activities.name: Study Protocol Uniform Resource Locator Description
activities.definition: A textual description for the uniform resource locator of a clinical study protocol.

activities.name: Study Saved as XML Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether the data submitted to EudraCT should be saved to EudraCT as an XML file.
synonyms: Request for XML Copy of Study Indicator

activities.name: Study Site Transfer
activities.definition: The study subject has been assigned to a different study site.

activities.name: Study Start Date
activities.definition: The date on which a study began.

activities.name: Study Status
activities.definition: The status of a study or trial.

activities.name: Study Stop Rule
activities.definition: The rule, regulation and/or condition that determines the point in time when a clinical trial will be terminated.

activities.name: Study Subject Group Characteristics
activities.definition: Study Subject Group Characteristics

activities.name: Study Terminated By Sponsor
activities.definition: An indication that a clinical study was stopped by its sponsor.

activities.name: Study Type
activities.definition: The nature of the investigation or the investigational use for which the study is being done.

activities.name: Subject Age
activities.definition: The age of a person who is the subject in a study.

activities.name: Subject is Randomized
activities.definition: A status indication that a subject is already assigned to an arm of a clinical trial by chance.

activities.name: Subject Pregnancy
activities.definition: SDTM DS domain: Subject Pregnancy

activities.name: Subject Removed at Sponsor Request
activities.definition: An indication that the study subject was removed from the study at the sponsor's request.

activities.name: Substudy Details
activities.definition: A textual description of the substudy.

activities.name: Substudy Planned Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether a study performed on a subgroup of subjects included in the original trial is planned to be included as part of the current study.

activities.name: SUSAR Reporting to EudraVigiliance Clinical Trial Module Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions will be reported to a EudraVigiliance clinical trial module.

activities.name: SUSAR Reporting to National Competent Authority Indicator
activities.definition: An indication as to whether suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions will be reported to national competent authorities.

activities.name: Telephone Number
activities.definition: A sequence of decimal digits (0-9) that is used for identifying a destination telephone line or other device in a telephone network.

activities.name: Temporal Qualifier
activities.definition: Terms used to indicate units of time or other terms associated with time.

activities.name: Test Product Added to Existing Treatment
activities.definition: An indication that an investigational drug or substance has been added to the existing treatment regimen.

activities.name: Therapeutic Area
activities.definition: A knowledge field that focuses on research and development of treatments for diseases and pathologic findings, as well as prevention of conditions that negatively impact the health of an individual.

activities.name: Therapeutic Procedure
activities.definition: Medical care intended to treat or cure a condition or lessen its symptoms. This includes the administration of drugs, surgical procedures, physical or psychotherapy, or the use of therapeutic devices.

activities.name: Title
activities.definition: An official descriptive name of a document, e.g. the long name of a study protocol provided by the study sponsor.

activities.name: Treatment Regimen
activities.definition: A treatment plan that specifies the dosage, the schedule, and the duration of treatment.

activities.name: Treatment Unblinded
activities.definition: SDTM DS domain: Treatment Unblinded

activities.name: Trial Blinding Schema
